title: Git hooks
current: Yoke installs no Git hooks. Refresh, dev setup and uninstall remove recognized shims from older releases and preserve other hooks. Harness edits and Yoke merge preflight still check file length. Yoke CI checks its own authored-file contracts. Project teams can run yoke check file-line --staged before a direct Git commit. The installed-file check and staged-file divergence warning are retired. Yoke reconciles the live lane HEAD when it needs the commit for QA, review, merge, done or deployment.
